title: SQL Visual Optimizer: An Interactive Query Planning, Cost Analysis, and SQL Performance Laboratory
description: SQL Visual Optimizer is a browser-first research and educational software application for inspecting SQL structure, visualizing transparent estimated logical plans, importing PostgreSQL-compatible EXPLAIN JSON, identifying common SQL anti-patterns, and exploring index hypotheses. The deterministic analyzer works without a paid API or project-owned credential; optional natural-language explanations use a visitor-provided Gemini API key.
notes: Version 1.0.0 is the initial public research-software release. Archived version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21501361. The live application is deployed on GitHub Pages and the source code is licensed under MIT.
